description.value:
Frequency 1/encounter

Damage ~4d6+10 or equivalent control effect

Signature Maneuver 2 actions

The fragment has grown into something that would object to being called an "it." Your Ghost-Rig acts on its own initiative count as a fully independent ally whether or not you spend any actions on it, retains its personality and memories across chassis repairs or even full rebuilds, and gains a once-per-encounter signature maneuver (a name and effect you set at this tier) that ignores its own Slippage risk.

cinderfall.incomplete: [RIG-NO-ACTOR] -- entirely about the non-existent companion actor; the "signature maneuver" clause is additionally undefined-by-design (its numbers are set by the player at the table), so it has no fixed effect to encode even setting the actor problem aside.
